metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct safety_rule for real-time agent failure detection and escalation. It differs semantically from existing skills: not a macro observability protocol (OpenTelemetry), not a dependency/repository configuration skill, and not a cost/SDK lifecycle skill. Peer candidates (cost monitoring, SDK state check, session init) operate at different task families and stages. No existing skill covers failure classification, anomaly detection, and escalation routing for agent sessions. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap validates the capability need.
